import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    P = list(map(int, data[1:1+N]))
    
    size = N
    bit = [0] * (size + 2)
    # Initialize all ones in O(N)
    for i in range(1, size + 1):
        bit[i] += 1
        j = i + (i & -i)
        if j <= size:
            bit[j] += bit[i]
    
    LOG = 0
    while (1 << (LOG + 1)) <= size:
        LOG += 1
    
    result = [0] * (N + 1)
    
    for i in range(N, 0, -1):
        k = P[i - 1]
        pos = 0
        for r in range(LOG, -1, -1):
            nxt = pos + (1 << r)
            if nxt <= size and bit[nxt] < k:
                pos = nxt
                k -= bit[pos]
        pos += 1
        result[pos] = i
        j = pos
        while j <= size:
            bit[j] -= 1
            j += j & -j
    
    sys.stdout.write(' '.join(map(str, result[1:])))
